name: oxid-stripe-wallet
description: Stripe Payment Module with Stimulus.js for OXID eShop

scripts.build:dev: npm run copy:stimulus && esbuild assets/src/js/app.js --bundle --outfile=out/js/stripe.dev.js --sourcemap --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"' && esbuild assets/src/js/controllers/*.js --outdir=out/js/controllers --sourcemap --format=esm && chmod -R 755 out
scripts.copy:stimulus: mkdir -p out/js/vendors && cp node_modules/@hotwired/stimulus/dist/stimulus.js out/js/vendors/ && chmod 644 out/js/vendors/stimulus.js
scripts.watch: npm run build:dev && concurrently "npm run watch:app" "npm run watch:controllers"

author: OXID Solution Catalysts
